summary: An app's sidebar: a workspace switcher, grouped links with badges and the signed-in user's menu at the bottom.

props.name: current
props.description: The `href` of the page shown first, marked as current until a link is picked.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called with a link's `href` when it is picked.

props.name: user
props.description: Who is signed in, shown at the bottom with their menu.

props.name: brand
props.description: The app's name and mark at the top.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called with the text typed into the search field.

props.name: accounts
props.description: Every account the switcher in the user menu lists, the signed-in one included.

props.name: onAccountChange
props.description: Called with an account's email when it is picked from the switcher.

props.name: onAddAccount
props.description: Called when Add account is picked from the switcher.

props.name: status
props.description: The user's status, shown on their avatar and picked from their menu.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called with the status picked from the user menu.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called when Sign out is picked from the user menu.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the links, menus, badges & avatar.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the menus are portalled. Leave unset to portal into `document.body`; pass an element to keep them inside a scrolling frame.
